title: Emergence
author: Michael Dubruiel (DubruielComposition)
attribution_text: "Emergence" by Michael Dubruiel (DubruielComposition), 2023 - https://opengameart.org/content/emergence - licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
description: Orchestral cue for horns, orchestral strings and bright piano; the composer calls it wonder-inducing and uplifting, for an introduction, revelation or victory. Lossless 16-bit/44.1k WAV. Starts very soft (about -38 dB RMS) and swells steadily to a full peak around 36-66s, then several smaller swells and a soft tail to 127s.
why_it_fits: Best overall match: strings + piano + horns with a slow build from hush to full swell, i.e. the reveal/awe arc. A 30s edit from roughly 10s to 40s of the file (or a cut that lands the ~36s peak on the 16s valley reveal) gives quiet frozen opening -> bloom -> soaring climax. Highest audio quality of the set.

title: Reunited
author: Kevin MacLeod
attribution_text:
"Reunited" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0
http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
description: Short warm theme for piano, cellos, violins and light drum kit (catalog feel: Bright, Relaxed, Uplifting). 71s; composer notes it really opens up at 38 seconds. Loudest section about 36-48s, then fades out by about 60s.
why_it_fits: Nearly film length already. Using roughly 31s-61s of the file puts the 38s opening-up at about 7s of the film (the bud burst), the full section under the bloom wave, and the natural fade as the resolve. Piano + strings emotional colour is close to the Ghibli-wonder brief; the light drum kit is the only off-brief element.

title: Overture and Fanfare
author: Anapwodicn (freesound user)
attribution_text: None required (CC0). Optional credit: "Overture and Fanfare" by Anapwodicn (freesound.org/s/660410).
description: 41s orchestral opening tagged Magical / Disney / Overture; author: an orchestral opening, victorious sounding, ending with a fanfare. Strong from about 3s to 20s, then a softer passage leading into a closing fanfare. File is the freesound HQ preview (VBR about 176 kbps).
why_it_fits: Short, self-contained, fairy-tale/Disney-style magical orchestral piece with a beginning, energetic middle and fanfare ending, so it fits 30s with minimal editing. Good energetic option for the 7-16s bloom wave.

title: City in the Clouds
author: Peter Eastman (peastman)
attribution_text: "City in the Clouds" by Peter Eastman - https://opengameart.org/content/city-in-the-clouds - licensed under CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/)
description: 140s melodic orchestral piece meant to evoke a magical land floating high among the clouds (rough draft from the album The Perilous Journey: Imaginary Music From A Fantasy Video Game). Soft intro, full by about 15s, fairly steady after that. Ogg Vorbis about 133 kbps.
why_it_fits: Explicitly magical, floating fantasy-orchestral mood close to Ghibli-like wonder; suits the rising camera reveal of the valley. Below the preferred 192 kbps (Vorbis about 133 kbps), so treat it as a mood alternative rather than first choice.

title: Ashton Manor
author: Kevin MacLeod
attribution_text:
"Ashton Manor" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0
http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
description: 44s pastoral orchestral cue: flute and clarinet float over a moving string section with harp (feel: Bright, Uplifting, Calming); change in tone at 26s.
why_it_fits: Pastoral strings + harp + woodwinds read as nature documentary / spring morning. Short enough to use almost whole. Gentle rather than a big swell, so better for the resolve or as a layer than as the main climax cue.

title: And Awaken
author: Kevin MacLeod
attribution_text:
"And Awaken" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0
http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
description: 29.7s cue: sweet sounding French horns opposite clarinet with harps. Fairly even level, gentle fade at the end.
why_it_fits: Exactly film length and thematically on point (spring awakening). Horns + harps give a warm, majestic-but-gentle colour; usable as-is or as an underlayer. No dramatic hit at 6-7s, so pair it with a stinger.

title: Infinite Perspective
author: Kevin MacLeod
attribution_text:
"Infinite Perspective" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0
http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
description: 5:45 piece for synths, wordless voices, piano, harp, English horn, French horn and flute; composer: all the beauty, awe and calm majesty you can handle. Level is very flat (about -17 dB RMS throughout), no big build.
why_it_fits: Strong awe / calm-majesty colour for the valley reveal and the 25-30s resolve; any 10-15s section can be cut out. Not a builder: use as a bed under the climax, not as the main swell.

title: Cinematic Hit With Horns
author: DeVern (freesound user)
attribution_text: None required (CC0). Optional credit: "Cinematic Hit With Horns" by DeVern (freesound.org/s/427803).
description: STINGER. 4.4s loud cinematic orchestral hit: horns, timpani/drums, impact (tags: blast, cinematic, hit, horns, impact, orchestra, timpani). Peaks immediately and decays over about 3s.
why_it_fits: The big musical HIT for the bud burst at about 6-7s; hard transient + brass gives a strong sync point. May need EQ/level work to blend with a gentler score.

title: Orchestral Hits 2 in C major (13 Variations)
author: MathewHenry (freesound user)
attribution_text: None required (CC0). Optional credit: "Orchestral Hits 2 in C major" by MathewHenry (freesound.org/s/683255).
description: STINGER PACK. 13 C-major orchestral hits, one every 4.8s (A 0.0s, B 4.8s, C 9.6s, D 14.4s, E 19.2s, F 24.0s, G 28.8s, H 33.6s, I 38.4s, J 43.2s, K 48.0s, L 52.8s, M 57.6s). A = full orchestra with cymbals and bells; B = without cymbals/bells; C = no untuned percussion; D = col legno strings; E = no woodwinds; F = no brass; G = no percussion; H = brass + percussion; I = woodwinds + percussion; J = strings + percussion; K = col legno strings + percussion; L = strings + woodwinds; M = strings + brass. Each hit about 3.5s.
why_it_fits: Variation A (0.0-4.0s: major chord + bells + cymbal) is the most magical-impact hit for the bud burst; the major key keeps it bright and hopeful rather than trailer-dark. The other variations let the hit match the instrumentation of whichever score is chosen (pitch-shift to the score key if needed).

title: Angelic Fanfare 3
author: qubodup (freesound user)
attribution_text: None required (CC0). Optional credit: "Angelic Fanfare 3" by qubodup (freesound.org/s/812469).
description: STINGER. 5.7s simple celebratory, heavenly melody (FL Studio / Kontakt / wordless Vocalise choir); tags: angelic, ethereal, fantasy, majestic, radiant. Rises over about 1s, sustains about 3s, then decays.
why_it_fits: Softer, shimmering magical-bloom accent (wordless, no lyrics): layer under or just after the hard hit at 6-7s, or use at the 16s valley reveal.
